prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) and finish layout changes (finish, layout) consistently degraded performance.
Sign-in redesigns (sign_in, redesign) consistently underperformed, producing multiple losses and no winning tests.
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance across multiple tests.
Sign-in hints, adoption new screens, and home wait-info changes proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests, though many tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the positive gains achieved by winning tests.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_multi_device_pet_sync_hint: Displays a clear hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that signing into an existing account restores saved pets immediately. (why: Support received 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in with different credentials.)
1: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_lighting_tips_hint: Adds an explanatory hint on photo upload detailing optimal lighting and photo quality for realistic pet rendering. (why: Support mail logged 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or producing unexpected visuals.)
2: [home, new_flow] waiting_desktop_ready_notification_new_flow: Adds a desktop notification preference toggle on the rendering screen so users are alerted when pet setup finishes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, causing users to minimize the screen and lose track of completion.)
3: [finish, hint] home_intro_pet_visibility_shortcut_hint: Displays a clear hint on the final onboarding screen highlighting the system tray shortcut for summoning and hiding the pet. (why: Support mail shows post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding, showing, and interacting with pets on the desktop.)
4: [choose_path, copy] story_companion_journey_overview_copy: Updates story intro headline and body text to set clear expectations for quick pet adoption steps. (why: Initial story screen drop-off sets the baseline for overall onboarding conversion (currently 29.6%).)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have a strong winning track record (+1.6% avg), and support mail explicitly points to pet sync confusion.
Adoption step has high drop-off (25.5%), but adoption hints previously underperformed (-4.9%).
Extremely high home step wait time (2336s mean) supports this change, though new flow implementation incurs higher dev cost.
Finish step loses 35.2% of users, but historical tests show finish hints consistently lose conversion (-0.6% avg).
Choose_path copy changes consistently perform well (+3.1% avg across 3 tests), though support mail evidence is absent.
